body:
Consolidates Aurora’s live workspace, shared UI, native event bridge, encrypted transcript archive/configuration, native speech routing and on-device Assistant work in one draft PR targeting main. The frontend and archive commits are included, along with the four reviewed conditional transcript-library plan files. No transcript-library screen is included.

Local Assistant failures now retain their canonical error code through the foreground controller, shared failure handler and failed message state. Previously those failures kept safe display text but discarded the existing typed code. Display text remains safe, existing two-argument callers remain compatible, and a failed inference remains a failure. One connected regression failed before the repair, then all 12 affected tests and the UI typecheck passed; independent Sol approved the exact four-file patch.

The Android settings main passed configuration change/readback, exact Assistant draft and original UI preservation, role and all ownership cleanup checks in run38175035664 at tested head9c39f726. At current PR headc0f4c001, run38181244731 failed the packaged Android15 flow: native speech pairing reached session_error with verified cleanup, and the independent offline Assistant attempt rendered an error with canonical validation code rather than an accepted reply or saved answer. That code has several possible origins and the current primary does not identify one cause; no speculative source patch is included. Current configuration/draft acceptance is not established by those failure summaries. Required iOS native speech readiness remains unaccepted.

At current c0f4c001, frontend/SDK, quality, backend conformance, Rust voice, WebRTC interop, iOS policy/signing and Docker checks passed. Desktop packages and the Linux real Python-peer main passed; macOS live Python-peer STUN failed session_error with no concrete product-versus-network cause. Existing iOS baseline38181244730 completed successfully at2026-10-12T00:05:35Z with48 successful steps: app install/launch, MobileSafari and packaged WKWebView direct/STUN/TURN pairing passed. Its exact native speech and Assistant step32 was skipped, so native speech remains unaccepted. Historical real hosted/bilateral mains and ordinary packaged pairing retain their original tested-head attribution. Compilation, skipped voice and prior passes do not establish current native reply acceptance or merge readiness.

Current Python CI failed on a missing separately installed chat backend, stale generated inventory references and an obsolete Android workflow assertion. The exact three-file correction is committed locally at25c7b56: existing pinned CPU backend setup,36 regenerated source-line pointers and a guard aligned with the maintained packaged main-flow wrapper. Ten targeted checks and static checks passed, with independent Sol source approval. This correction is not yet in this PR: GitHub rejected its single publication attempt because coding-worker’s Personal Access Token lacks workflow scope for the existing python-tests.yml update. The prepared commit/bundle and all branch work are preserved; fresh configured-runner installation and full Python CI remain unverified.

The existing production Rust native inference main_flow example passed once on Linux ARM64 using the provisioned pinned Qwen3.5-0.8B GGUF and verified static llama.cpp runtime. It returned a nonempty finite message and a valid lookup_color tool proposal in88.01 seconds including compilation. The exercised Rust tree is identical to this PR head; Root tested it from dcdbc99 with cargo --offline --locked and the existing native-llamacpp feature. This isolates native inference; Tauri/WebView rendering, SDK saved conversation, Android Needle2, iOS Cactus, speech and mesh are separate unaccepted scopes. No further model/context/tool-edge matrix was run.

Remaining acceptance: Android/iOS native speech and offline reply/history, required lifecycle/capture/performance mains, source Astra final visual approval, full speech review/integration record and external task acknowledgements. Telemetry remains unstarted until accepted native speech and PRE-NATIVE-01–03. Closed passing checks and bounded unknown causes stay closed without an expanded edge-case matrix. Superseded PR174–176 are closed unmerged with branches preserved. No merge or deployment.
title: Connect Aurora workspace, archive, and native speech product flows
